classes.title: Executor runs loop on an exhausted context
classes.summary: A conversation's executor runs failed on context exhaustion several times in a row. The engine retires a session that runs out, so each launch should run on another session: with `session_continued` false, none of them fit its model's context, and the brief or the window is the likelier cause; with it true, a session that ran out was continued anyway.

classes.title: A seat's turns fail in a row at one place in the engine
classes.summary: A seat's turns failed in a row at the same function, or a message on its inbox was lost to such a failure, for a cause the engine could not attribute to a provider, a credential, a budget, a box or its environment. The report names the function the failure left the engine's code through; a report at this class's own site means no function on the way out recorded it yet.

classes.title: A seat's message was dead-lettered
classes.summary: A message on a seat's inbox used up its whole delivery budget on hand-backs, the deliveries the engine returned to the queue rather than ran, while no node was draining and every node ran one build, and was moved to the dead-letter subject. The person or system that sent it was not answered. The report names why its last delivery was handed back.

classes.title: A turn panicked
classes.summary: A panic was recovered while handling a seat's turn. A panic is a defect in the engine rather than in anything it talks to. The report names the function that panicked, from the engine's public source; the panic's value and stack stay on the node's log.

classes.title: An executor run was stranded by the engine
classes.summary: An executor's run ended with no turn able to resume it, for a reason the engine documents as an invariant of its own and not as its environment or a person's act: the run's record held none of its turn's parked state, its turn suspended with no conversation recorded, or every attempt to resume a finished job failed on an error the engine could not attribute elsewhere. The `reason` says which.
